answer: A secure haven relies on cryptographic attestation chains and zero-knowledge proofs to verify hardware identity while keeping algorithmic secrets crystal clear without disclosure. When verifying clusters, the protocol enforces exponential capital exhaustion through compounding collateral requirements: each additional node in a Sybil swarm demands superlinear staking fees. Even if rogue nodes spread like wild yarrow across peers, attacker costs scale exponentially, bankrupting forged identities.
